services.name: Independence Day Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: 1.5 Hours About View the fireworks from the distinct advantage of being on the water for an incredible view!!! Departure is 9:00 PM and returning after the fireworks Boarding is at 8:45 PM at 184 Sweeney right on the view fireworks from the water

services.name: Father's Day Cruise with DJ/Karaoke by DJ MXN / Mixon Music
services.desc: 1.5 Hour cruise About Surprise your father, dad, step-father, etc. You won't want to miss our on this great cruise. What a fun way to celebrate Fathers All Ages • Make it a special Father's Day cruise!

services.name: Psychic Cruise
services.desc: with WNY’s leading Psychic Reverends, Ellen Bourn along with Krista Conover 2.0 Hours About Join WNY’s leading Psychic Reverends, Ellen Bourn along with Krista Conover. They will Open the Portals of the Other Side of Life. Their’’ Gallery Style’’ event will include Messages of Inspiration, Connections to your Angels, Spirit Guides, and Loved Ones. Departing from our docks at 184 Sweeney street, North Tonawanda. Departure time varies depending on the month. Boarding promptly 15 minutes before departure. Bring your own snacks and drinks on board to enjoy during the All Ages • 2.0 Hours • "Gallery Style" event with WNY leading Psychics

services.name: Live Blues Cruise
services.desc: Listen to live Blues being played while cruising the river under sunset skies! 2 Hours About Come join us for some great live Blues music with a 3-piece band led by Barry Arbogast (Chicago Tribute Band) on saxophone along with Shaun Duchescherer, Jack McAdrdle (12 Pack Jack) and Eric Malinowski on percussion. Bring your own drinks and snacks while enjoying the sunset All Ages • 2 Hours • Live Blues with 3 piece band

services.name: Joe Bolognese Music Cruise
services.desc: Joe Bolognese is a well known multi-talented music man based in Buffalo, New York. 1.5 Hours About Joe has been the opening music act for Headliners & Worldwide Hall of Fame Bands & Artists. Get your family, friends or group together for this amazingly entertaining experience. You have probably seen Joe perform at local hot spots such as the Hideaway Grill. Amazing show paired with the most amazing sunset skies along the Upper Niagara River and historic Erie All Ages • 1.5 Hours • Live Music!

services.name: Civiletto Sings Sinatra Co-starring April Mazzone
services.desc: 2 Hours About Enjoy a wonderful evening cruise on the upper Niagara River and watch the sun set as Jack Civiletto sings Sinatra Co-starring April Mazzone. Jack Civiletto and April Mazzone are a wonderful blend of two exceptional talents…...Jack Civiletto shows off his award winning smooth and stylish vocals …...April Mazzone displays a passionate, heartfelt vocal style. Now they will be on the Queen of Peace!!! Amazing show paired with the most amazing sunset skies along the Upper Niagara River and historic Erie 2 Hours • Live Music • Civiletto sings Sinatra Co-starring April Mazzone
